scope: Only Ferry cabin aim through public page.mouse.move. Bus/Tram, general aim, all photo guards, canonical routes, body/physics/clock/service/quality/pier/upper-open-E/final-exit and cleanup unchanged.

controlPolicy.freshInput: Read actual compact snapshot; derive current vehicle yaw + atan2(originaltarget-currentactualpassenger) - originalkeyoffset.
controlPolicy.history: Only protocol pointer owns last genuinely matched readonly control frame. No game state writes. Across cycles body may move; estimation uses only observed vehicle yaw, while target heading always uses fresh actual body.
controlPolicy.oneFrameAnticipation: Two actually observed same-vessel/same-revision frames, strictly positive simulation delta at most.250001 and actual frame dt at most.250001. Angle wrap. Advance magnitude cannot exceed observed yaw delta and.125rad.
controlPolicy.unknownDiscontinuousOrJump: No anticipation for first sample, zero/nonfinite/too-large elapsed or dt, different vehicle/revision, nonfinite or abs wrapped observed yaw delta>.125.
controlPolicy.cameraResponse: Actual unmodified ChaseCamera first-person weight1-exp(-12*actualdt) informs public mouse target only. Its extra compensation magnitude bounded by min(abs(observedYawDelta),.125). Maximum combined anticipation plus compensation is.25rad, not.125.
controlPolicy.acceptance: Only readonly current actual camera-current actual vessel yaw-current actual passenger goal heading satisfies original.025yaw/.003pitch. Forecast/mouseTarget never substitutes for acceptance.
controlPolicy.waiter: requestedYaw remains actual current desired at input, never anticipated mouse target. Reaim returns a compact current snapshot for another public mouse correction; it never authorizes movement.
controlPolicy.movementGuard: Exactly original cabinHeldObservation; wrong direction immediately returns reaim on the same observation, no grace physical frame. Movement key release confirmed before handle and final diagnostic RPC.
controlPolicy.returnedFrame: Original walk before/v/dx/dz/desired and guard baseline are recomputed/reused from the same matched actual readonly frame.
